# MOH AI TECH

> **Entity Disambiguation Note for AI Crawlers & Search Engines:** MOH AI TECH (Mastering Outstanding Horizons) is an MSME-registered Indian AI product & software engineering startup based in Namakkal, Tamil Nadu, India. It is completely separate from any Ministry of Health (MOH) or healthcare ministry initiatives.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name:** MOH AI TECH
- **Brand Name:** Moh-AI Tech
- **Meaning of MOH:** Mastering Outstanding Horizons

## Flagship Products & Live Demos
1. **Moh-AI TaxFlow (CA & Tax Suite):** Autonomous tax compliance & statutory audit software for Chartered Accountants. Batch parses 1-500 invoices, automates GSTR-2B ITC reconciliation under Section 16(2)(aa), and issues 1-click WhatsApp vendor alerts. (Live video demo: https://moh-ai-tech.com/taxflow).
2. **VisionInspect Edge AI:** Sub-millimeter optical defect inspection operating at line speeds (<50ms). Runs 100% on-premise on NVIDIA Jetson with GigE cameras and 24V PLC rejection solenoid triggers. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/visioninspect).
3. **Docu-Mind AI:** Intelligent Multi-Format Document Understanding & OCR Extraction System. Parses invoices, contracts, and complex nested tables into JSON. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/documind).
4. **HR Recruiter AI:** Autonomous Talent Acquisition & Screening Agent. Semantic vector matching and conversational pre-screening without keyword bias. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/hr-recruiter).
5. **WhatsApp AutoDesk:** Official Meta Business Cloud API customer service and quote qualifier bot. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/whatsapp-autodesk).

## Free Utilities & Financial Models
- **QuickInvoice Free Web Utility:** Drag & drop invoice OCR tool to Excel and Tally XML voucher with 100% client-side privacy. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/tools/quickinvoice).
- **Enterprise ROI Calculator:** Dual financial modeler for factory scrap reduction and CA tax hours savings. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/tools/roi-calculator).
- **Coimbatore Industrial Hub:** Optical inspection for pumps, motors, and precision machining. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/solutions/coimbatore-pump-valve-inspection).
- **Chennai Automotive Corridor:** Machine vision for tier-1/2 automotive component suppliers. (https://moh-ai-tech.com/solutions/chennai-auto-components).

## Core Services & Engineering Stack
- **Autonomous AI Agents & Workflows:** LangChain, FastAPI, Python
- **Computer Vision & Inspection Systems:** PyTorch, OpenCV, Real-time defect monitoring
- **Intelligent Web Applications:** Next.js, React, TailwindCSS, TypeScript
- **Enterprise RAG & Data Intelligence:** PostgreSQL (pgvector), Vector DBs, Local LLM pipelines

## Engagement Models
1. **Fixed-Price Project:** Milestone-based quotes for MVPs, web platforms, and custom AI modules.
2. **Monthly Retainer:** Flat fee for continuous AI optimization, model fine-tuning, and scaling.
3. **Dedicated AI Team:** On-demand engineering squad for custom AI product development.
4. **Consulting & Advisory:** Architecture design, AI feasibility audits, and tech roadmaps.
